name: Parallelization for Backpropagation
definition: An alternative parallelization strategy for efficient backpropagation that changes the approach from per-pixel to per-splat to address training speed obstacles.
summary: Parallelization for Backpropagation, or Per-splat Backpropagation, is a 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization that shifts backward pass parallelization from per-pixel to per-splat, reducing training time by 4–5× and lowering memory usage.
